scope: 41 frozen person_2 candidate drafts plus title_extra office-title draft; source and fact checks against pinned WEB Acts text; no draft/evidence edits
methodJa: 各凍結draftを現物から再読しmanifest SHAと照合。knownByの固定WEBテキスト、summary/subtitle/identityNote/historicalRole、passages、factsの各knownByとsourceIds、参照URLを照合した。旧レビューを転用せず、本文が存在しないWEB異本節や原文にない導入情報を別途指摘。

sourceValidation.notesJa: 全profile factsにsourceIdsと該当節があり、各WEB source IDは節番号に整合。例外として空節8:37がJesus/God passagesに紛れ込む。

records.knownByWEBText: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.

factChecks.textJa: 20:4にはデルベ出身の別のガイオが記される。使徒言行録本文は19:29のガイオと同一人物かどうかを明示しない。
factChecks.webText: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.

records.evidenceJa: ACT 19:29 はGaiusを名指し、Macedonia出身でPaulの旅の仲間と記す。ACT 20:4にはDerbe出身の同名Gaiusがいるが、本文は19:29の人物と同一か明示しないというfactは適切。

records.knownByWEBText: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 20:4 はGaius of Derbeを名指し、Paul一行に伴われてAsiaまで進んだ人々の一人に列挙する。最初の記述と地名由来は本文どおり。

records.knownByWEBText: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,

factChecks.textJa: ガリオは訴えを不正や犯罪ではなく、ユダヤ人の律法・言葉をめぐる争いとして扱った。
factChecks.webText: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;

factChecks.textJa: ソステネが法廷の前で打たれた際、ガリオは介入しなかった。
factChecks.webText: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.

records.evidenceJa: ACT 18:12 はGallioをAchaiaのproconsulとし、Paulを法廷へ連れて来たことを記す。18:14の訴えの性質、18:17のSosthenesへの不介入は各factの引用範囲に一致。

records.knownByWEBText: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

factChecks.textJa: パウロは自分がエルサレムでガマリエルのもとに律法を学んだと述べる。
factChecks.webText: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.

records.evidenceJa: ACT 5:34 はGamalielを議会内のPharisee、律法教師として直接記す。ACT 22:3 のPaulによる師事告白を別factとして後段に置いている。

records.knownByWEBText: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.

factChecks.textJa: 神がイエスを死者の中からよみがえらせたと使徒たちが証言する。
factChecks.webText: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

factChecks.textJa: ペトロは、神が人を分け隔てしないと語る。
factChecks.webText: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;

records.evidenceJa: 大部分の初出・factは固定WEBに合うが、passagesにACT 8:37を含める。固定WEB acts-web-verses.json は同節textStatus=empty、text=""。契約に従えばこの異本節を profile に補えず、該当節・source idを除く必要がある。

records.knownByWEBText: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 7:16 はAbrahamが墓をHamor of Shechemの子らから買ったと記す。「一族の祖」は「children of Hamor」からの控えめな系譜解釈であり、本文記述の範囲を超える具体的な伝記は足していない。

records.knownByWEBText: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 23:35 はaccusersが到着したら聞くこと、Herod’s palaceで保管する命令を記すだけで、Heberという人名は一切ない。profileはpassagesを空にし誤リンクを明言しているので候補排除の扱いは適切。ただしknownBy 23:35は実出現ではなく誤リンク検査箇所であり、その区別がフィールド上は誤解を招く余地あり。

records.knownByWEBText: “For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,

factChecks.textJa: アンティオキア教会の教師マナエンは、「ヘロデの乳兄弟」と紹介される。
factChecks.webText: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

records.evidenceJa: ACT 4:27 は「Herod」とだけ記し、13:1 は「Herod the tetrarch」と記す。原稿は初出4:27の文面がAntipasや称号を示さないと正しく限定し、後の13:1を別factに置く。4:27のHerodと13:1のtetrarchを同一IDに結ぶのは索引に基づく関連付けで、固定WEBだけでは同一性を明言しない。

records.knownByWEBText: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

factChecks.textJa: アグリッパ王はヨハネの兄弟ヤコブを剣で殺した。
factChecks.webText: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

factChecks.textJa: 王はユダヤ人たちに喜ばれたのを見て、ペトロも捕らえた。
factChecks.webText: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

factChecks.textJa: ペトロが見つからないと、王は番兵を取り調べ、カイサリアへ下った。
factChecks.webText: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

factChecks.textJa: 王は公の場で演説し、民衆の歓声を受けた。
factChecks.webText: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

records.evidenceJa: ACT 12:1 は「King Herod」とだけ記し、12章内で同じ王の行為を継続する。draftはAgrippa I同定を「通常」と限定し、Wikipedia照合を別に示す点は適切。一方subtitleの「ユダヤの王」は初出12:1には書かれず、王の身元と支配地域は本文・外部同定を合わせた解釈である。

records.knownByWEBText: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.

factChecks.textJa: 弟子たちは聖霊に満たされ、他の言語で語り始めた。
factChecks.webText: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

factChecks.textJa: アンティオキアの教会で、聖霊がバルナバとサウロを務めのために取り分けるよう告げた。
factChecks.webText: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”

records.evidenceJa: ACT 1:2 はHoly Spiritが使徒たちに命令した経路として初出し、各factのACT 2:4と13:2も本文に明記される。passage参照は全てpresentの固定WEBに対応。

records.knownByWEBText: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

factChecks.textJa: ステファノの回顧では、アブラハムがイサクの父、イサクがヤコブの父として系譜が述べられる。
factChecks.webText: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

records.evidenceJa: ACT 3:13 はAbraham・Isaac・Jacobを族長として並記し、7:8はAbraham→Isaac→Jacobの系譜を述べる。summary/factはこの本文だけに沿う。

records.knownByWEBText: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 8:28 は「prophet Isaiah」を直接記し、8:30と28:25の別出現・預言者引用もsource linkで示される。初出を8:28に置いている。

records.knownByWEBText: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 3:13、7:8、7:12、7:14、7:15、7:32、7:46にある族長Jacobへの直接参照をperson:israel_682へ戻した。Gen 25:26開始のfull index appearances、Gen 32:28、Easton ISRAEL/JACOB evidenceでIsraelがJacobの別名と確認できる。ACT 5:21、7:23、7:37、9:15、10:36のchildren of Israelは共同体として除外している。

records.knownByWEBText: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

factChecks.textJa: 使徒言行録12:2はこのヤコブをヨハネの兄弟と明記し、ヘロデが剣で殺したと記す。
factChecks.webText: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

records.evidenceJa: ACT 1:13 は単独で名を挙げるJamesとAlphaeusの子Jamesを別々に列挙し、12:2はJohnの兄弟Jamesの処刑を記す。後続事実を1:13初出のsummaryに漏らさず12:2 factにゲートした。

records.knownByWEBText: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 1:13 は「James the son of Alphaeus」と明記し、同節内の別のJamesと識別できる。profileは一節だけを根拠にし、過剰な伝記を加えていない。

records.knownByWEBText: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.

factChecks.textJa: エルサレム会議でヤコブが発言し、異邦人信徒をめぐる議論をまとめる。
factChecks.webText: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.

factChecks.textJa: パウロはエルサレムでヤコブと長老たちを訪ねた。
factChecks.webText: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.

records.evidenceJa: ACT 12:17、15:13、21:18では同名Jamesへの言及が続く。原稿は家族関係がActsに書かれないこと、12:2およびAlphaeusの子との同一視を避けることを明記。12:17のJamesと後の会議・長老訪問時のJamesを同一人物とする点は本文の連続した使徒言行録内の文脈・索引に基づき、家族名による再確認はできない。

records.knownByWEBText: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.

factChecks.textJa: 告発者たちは、ヤソンがパウロたちを迎え入れたと主張した。
factChecks.webText: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”

factChecks.textJa: 町の当局はヤソンたちから保証金を受け取って釈放した。
factChecks.webText: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

records.evidenceJa: ACT 17:5 はJasonの家を襲ったと記し、17:7はPaul一行を迎え入れたという告発、17:9は保証金後の釈放を記す。later factsを17:5の導入に持ち込んでいない。

records.knownByWEBText: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’
records.evidenceJa: ACT 13:22 はDavidを「son of Jesse」と直接記し、summaryの父子関係はこの初出節そのものに根拠を持つ。

records.knownByWEBText: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,

factChecks.textJa: イエスは苦難の後、弟子たちに現れ、神の国について語った。
factChecks.webText: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.

factChecks.textJa: ペトロは、神がイエスを主またキリストとしたと宣言した。
factChecks.webText: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”

factChecks.textJa: サウロに語りかけた声は、自らをイエスと名乗る。
factChecks.webText: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

records.evidenceJa: 初出ACT 1:1とfacts 1:3、2:36、9:5はWEBに一致するが、passagesにACT 8:37を含む。固定WEBの同節はtextStatus=empty、text=""であり、unsupported variantをprofileに含めている。

records.knownByWEBText: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:
records.evidenceJa: ACT 2:16 はPeterの説明中で「prophet Joel」を明示する。knownByと唯一のpassage/sourceは一致。

records.knownByWEBText: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”
records.evidenceJa: ACT 1:5 はJohnの水による洗礼を対照として言及し、後続のActs出現も同じ洗礼伝承を参照する。初出・identity noteはこの根拠内にとどまる。

records.knownByWEBText: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 1:13 はJohnを使徒名簿に列挙し、summaryも初出と一致。しかしidentityNoteJaの「ペトロと行動する」は3:1以降に初めて分かる後続事実であり、knownBy 1:13のidentity noteへ先取りされている。名前だけでは曖昧なら、同名識別は初出で分かる情報に限定すべき。

records.knownByWEBText: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 4:6 はAnnasの親族らと並ぶJohnを列挙し、summaryは本文に詳しい身元がないことを限定。使徒Johnとの混同を避けるidentity noteも適合。

records.knownByWEBText: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him

factChecks.textJa: ヨセフは父ヤコブと親族をエジプトへ呼び寄せた。
factChecks.webText: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.

factChecks.textJa: ヨセフの死後、彼を知らない別の王がエジプトを治めた。
factChecks.webText: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.

records.evidenceJa: ACT 7:9 は兄たちがJosephをEgyptへ売ったこと、7:14はJacobと親族を呼び寄せたこと、7:18はJosephを知らない別王の登場を記す。factsの「Josephの死後」はACT 7:18に明言されていないため、「後に別の王が立ちJosephを知らなかった」へ弱めるのが原典限定ではより正確。

records.knownByWEBText: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,
records.evidenceJa: ACT 7:45 は先祖たちがJoshuaとともに入り、神が諸国民を追い出したと記す。summaryはこの節以上の伝記を追加していない。

records.knownByWEBText: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 5:37 は「Judas of Galilee」、人口調査の時期の蜂起・追随者離散・死を同じ節で記す。profileの各要素は初出節で分かる。

records.knownByWEBText: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,
records.evidenceJa: 固定WEB ACT 9:11 は家主名をJudahと綴り、KJV ACT 9:11はJudasと綴る。draftはこの表記差を隠さず、個人史を家主以上に推測しない。別の翻訳 witnessを同一の安定IDへ統合する処理は編集的同定である点を維持する。

records.knownByWEBText: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 15:22 は「Judas called Barsabbas」と名指し、15:27・32でもそのJudasとSilasが同じ任務・報告を続ける。別のJudasとの区別が明記される。

records.knownByWEBText: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.

factChecks.textJa: ユダが離れた使徒の務めを引き継ぐ者を選ぶ必要があると、ペトロは語った。
factChecks.webText: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”

records.evidenceJa: ACT 1:16 はJudasをJesusを捕らえた者たちのguideと明記し、1:25は彼が離れた使徒職務を記す。引渡しの説明と後続事実のsource gateが合う。

records.knownByWEBText: When it was determined that we should sail for Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius, of the Augustan band.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 27:1 はItalyへ出航する決定後、Paulら囚人をcenturion Juliusへ引き渡したことを初出として記すが、この節は最終目的地Romeを述べない。subtitleの「パウロをローマへ護送する任務」は28:14の到着を先取りしており、27:1時点の導入に置けない。

records.knownByWEBText: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 18:7 はJustusを名指し、神を礼拝し会堂の隣に家があると直接記す。summaryもPaulが会堂からJustusの家に移ったことだけに限定。

records.knownByWEBText: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 13:21 はSaulを「son of Kish」と直接記す。subtitleでSaulをイスラエル最初の王と呼ぶのは「王を求め、神がSaulを与えた」という同節の順序からの要約で、父子同定自体は直接。

records.knownByWEBText: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 1:13 自体は「Judas son of James」と記し、Lebbaeusとは呼ばない。JFB MAT 10:3はLebbaeusをLuke/ActsのJudas of Jamesと明示的に対応させ、Easton LEBBAEUS項も同じ使徒の別名として記載する。原稿はこの照合が二次資料による同定であると開示し、WEB本文の表記とは区別している。

records.knownByWEBText: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 13:1 はLucius of CyreneをAntiochのprophets/teachersの一人として名指す。初出まとめの地名・職務は同節にある。

records.knownByWEBText: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.

factChecks.textJa: リディアは家族とともに洗礼を受け、パウロ一行を自宅に迎えた。
factChecks.webText: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.

records.evidenceJa: ACT 16:14 はLydiaをThyatira出身の紫布商人、神を礼拝する者として明記。16:15の家族洗礼・歓待は別factに後置し、初出に先取りしていない。

records.knownByWEBText: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 13:1 はManaenをAntiochのprophets/teachersの一人、Herod the tetrarchのfoster brotherとして同時に紹介する。

records.knownByWEBText: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

factChecks.textJa: ヨハネ・マルコはバルナバとサウロに同行して旅立った。
factChecks.webText: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.

factChecks.textJa: 宣教旅行で同行したヨハネは、パンフィリアで一行を離れてエルサレムへ戻った。
factChecks.webText: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

records.evidenceJa: ACT 12:12 は「John who was called Mark」と母Maryを直接結び付ける。ACT 12:25、13:13の同行・離脱を後続factsでゲートし、同名のJohnと混同しない。

records.knownByWEBText: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 1:14 はMaryを「mother of Jesus」と明記し、summaryの祈り続ける群への位置づけを同節で示す。

records.knownByWEBText: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 12:12 はMary、John called Markの母、家に集まって祈る人々を記す。同節そのものはJerusalemと明記せず、subtitleの場所は直前の叙事文脈から推定される。related-sectionのWikipedia案内を含め、地域の明示性を区別しておく必要がある。

records.knownByWEBText: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.
records.evidenceJa: ACT 1:13 はMatthewを使徒名簿内に列挙する。profileは名簿以上の伝記・同一性を主張しない。

records.knownByWEBText: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.

factChecks.textJa: くじでマッティアが選ばれ、十一人の使徒に加えられた。
factChecks.webText: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.

records.evidenceJa: ACT 1:23 は候補としてMatthiasを挙げ、1:26はくじによる選出と使徒への加わりを述べる。後の選出をfactsで明示的に1:26へゲートしている。

records.knownByWEBText: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”

factChecks.textJa: パウロは、ユダヤ人の律法・神殿・カエサルに対して罪を犯していないとフェストゥスの前で述べます。
factChecks.webText: while he said in his defense, “Neither against the law of the Jews, nor against the temple, nor against Caesar, have I sinned at all.”

factChecks.textJa: パウロはカエサルの法廷で裁かれるべきだと述べます。
factChecks.webText: But Paul said, “I am standing before Caesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be tried. I have done no wrong to the Jews, as you also know very well.

factChecks.textJa: パウロは、死に値する罪があれば死を拒まないが、訴えが事実でなければ引き渡される理由はないとして、カエサルに上訴します。
factChecks.webText: For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I don’t refuse to die; but if none of those things is true that they accuse me of, no one can give me up to them. I appeal to Caesar!”

factChecks.textJa: フェストゥスは、カエサルに上訴したパウロに「カエサルのもとへ行く」と答えます。
factChecks.webText: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you shall go.”

factChecks.textJa: フェストゥスは、パウロが皇帝の裁定を求めたため、皇帝へ送るまで留置を命じたと説明します。
factChecks.webText: But when Paul had appealed to be kept for the decision of the emperor, I commanded him to be kept until I could send him to Caesar.”

factChecks.textJa: フェストゥスは、死に値することは見つからなかったが、パウロ自身が皇帝に上訴したため送ることを決めたと述べます。
factChecks.webText: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and as he himself appealed to the emperor, I determined to send him,

factChecks.textJa: アグリッパは、カエサルに上訴していなければパウロを釈放できたかもしれないとフェストゥスに述べます。
factChecks.webText: Agrippa said to Festus, “This man might have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar.”

factChecks.textJa: パウロは、カエサルの前に立つことが定められていると告げられます。
factChecks.webText: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’

factChecks.textJa: パウロは、同胞を告発する理由はないが、ユダヤ人たちの反対を受けてカエサルに上訴せざるを得なかったと述べます。
factChecks.webText: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.

records.evidenceJa: ACT 17:7はCaesarの命令と「別の王Jesus」という告発を初出として記す。25:8–12、25:21、25:25、26:32、27:24、28:19はCaesar/emperorへの訴え・審理職名を各factの本文で再確認できる。identityType=office-titleを明示し、Augustus/Nero等の個人へ同定しない。
